# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 2102546324, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> an ever-burning lantern in a vast stone vault of archive shelves full of journals and scrolls, travelers passing journals to one another, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
